title: 第15章 我和公主只是合作第16章 稿酬
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 刘柄缓步踱到瘫软在地的周刘培面前，脸上挂着那副宫里人见惯了的、看似和煦却让人心底发寒的笑容。
“娃娃，别怕。咱家问你，是谁亲手把药材交到你手上的？”
周刘培浑身抖得像风中的筛糠，但他知道这是唯一活命的机会，强撑着几乎涣散的精神，哑着嗓子回道“回……回老祖宗，是王培丰王公公给的药材……验、验毒也是他带人来做的……”
“哪个是王培丰？”
刘柄的声音不高，却像一道冰冷的锁链，瞬间勒紧了所有人的呼吸。
一阵腥臊味猛地弥漫开来——王太监竟吓得当场失禁，裤裆湿了一片，瘫在地上连连磕头“小、小人就是……老祖宗饶命！老祖宗饶命啊！”
刘柄眼皮都未抬，只淡淡追问“杂家再问你，那药材里混了东西，你可知情？”
豆大的汗珠从王太监额头滚落，他眼神慌乱地乱瞟，想说不知，可在那双仿佛能洞悉一切的眼睛注视下，谎话卡在喉咙里怎么也吐不出来。
万念俱灰间，他像是抓住了救命稻草，猛地扭头看向一旁的张胖子，尖声叫道“干爹！干爹救我啊！我都是为了……”
他后面那个关键的名字尚未出口，刘柄袖袍似是无意地一拂，一道无形气劲已精准地打中他的哑穴，让他只能发出嗬嗬的怪响，再也说不出半个字。
到了这一步，院内众人谁还不明白？
个个心底冒起寒气，噤若寒蝉。刘柄收回手，冰冷的目光先扫过面如死灰、瘫软如泥的张胖子，随即又落到强自镇定的牛掌印身上。
牛掌印虽未瘫倒，但后襟已被冷汗浸透，心中早已将张胖子这个“好干儿”骂了千万遍成事不足败事有余的蠢货！手脚不干净留下把柄，还差点把老子拖下水！还有那个书阁的小崽子，怎地如此多管闲事！
“牛珰，”
刘柄的声音打破死寂，“今日，这两人，连带这一摊子腌臜物，杂家带回内官监料理。你这尚膳监，杂家再容你整顿一次。若还管不明白……”
他顿了顿，语气平淡却重若千钧，“杂家不介意换个人来管。”
牛掌印如蒙大赦，连忙躬身，声音带着劫后余生的颤抖“多谢老祖宗恩典！老奴一定整顿！一定整顿！”
刘柄不再看他，吩咐左右，“把该带的人都带上，东西一件不许落下。谁要是敢在路上动什么手脚，仔细你们的皮！”
“是！”一众内官监太监齐声应诺，上前架起王太监和周刘培，抬起凉茶和药材，动作麻利，悄无声息。
刘柄转身便走，吴总管连忙小碎步跟上，李叶青也默默随在干爹身后。
一行人穿过宫墙夹道，脚步声几不可闻，气氛压抑。
行至一处僻静宫苑转角，刘柄停下脚步，对吴总管道“让你的人先带东西去内官监候着。”
“是。”吴总管连忙示意其他太监先行。
待旁人走远，现场只剩刘柄、吴总管和李叶青三人。
刘柄的目光第一次真正落在李叶青身上，上下打量了一番，忽然开口，声音依旧阴柔，却带着一丝探究“小子，身手不错。窝在书阁可惜了。东厂那边正缺机灵人，没宫里这么多弯弯绕，想不想去？”
李叶青心中一震，面上却不敢表露，恭敬垂首“回老祖宗，承蒙您看得起，小人感激不尽。只是……书阁那边还有些莲公主殿下交代的琐事未曾办妥，需得向殿下回禀一声方能离开。”
刘柄闻言，脸上那丝惯常的“和善”笑容真切了几分，竟带着点调侃“呵，倒是忘了你这层关系。罢了罢了，要是让那丫头知道杂家撬了她的人，非跑来揪光杂家这几根宝贝胡子不可！咱们这号人，攒几根胡子不易，杂家可得留着。”
他语气稍缓，带着一丝不易察觉的赞许“不过，你小子不错，知恩图报，临危不乱。小吴啊，你这个干儿子，收得好。”
旁边的吴总管直到此刻才敢稍稍直起腰，长舒一口憋了许久的气，赔着笑道“老祖宗谬赞了，都是托您的福，孩子才侥幸没给您丢脸。”
content_en:
Liu Bing walked slowly in front of Zhou Liupei, who was lying limply on the ground, with a smile on his face that everyone in the palace was used to seeing, which seemed warm but made people feel chilled in their hearts.
"Don't be afraid, baby. Let me ask you, who personally handed the medicinal materials into your hands?"
Zhou Liupei's whole body was shaking like chaff in the wind, but he knew that this was the only chance to survive. He held on to his almost exhausted energy and replied in a hoarse voice, "Back to...back to our ancestors, it was the medicinal materials given by Prince Wang Peifeng...he also brought people to do the testing and poison testing..."
"Which one is Wang Peifeng?"
Liu Bing's voice was not high, but like a cold chain, it instantly tightened everyone's breathing.
A fishy smell suddenly filled the air - Eunuch Wang was so frightened that he became incontinent on the spot, his crotch was soaked, and he collapsed on the ground and kowtowed repeatedly, "You, I, this little person... have mercy on me, my ancestors! Please have mercy on me, my ancestors!"
Liu Bin didn't even raise his eyelids, he just asked lightly, "Zhajia will ask you again, do you know that there is something mixed in the medicinal materials?"
Beads of sweat rolled down Eunuch Wang's forehead. He glanced around in panic, trying to say he didn't know, but under the gaze of those eyes that seemed to be able to see through everything, the lie was stuck in his throat and he couldn't spit it out.
With all his thoughts in despair, he seemed to have grasped a life-saving straw. He suddenly turned his head and looked at Fatty Zhang beside him, and screamed, "Godfather! Godfather, save me! I'm doing this all for..."
"Ugh!"
Before the key name behind him could be spoken, Liu Bing's sleeves flicked seemingly unintentionally, and an invisible force accurately hit his mute point, causing him to make only a strange sound of "ho ho" and unable to say another word.
At this point, who among the people in the hospital still doesn’t understand?
There was a chill in everyone's heart, and they were as silent as cicadas. Liu Bing retracted his hand, and his cold gaze first glanced at Fatty Zhang, who was ashen-faced and limp as mud, and then fell on Niu Zhangyin, who was trying to remain calm.
Although Niu Zangyin didn't collapse, his back was soaked with cold sweat. In his heart, he had already scolded Fatty Zhang, a "good guy", thousands of times for being a fool who failed to succeed but failed to succeed! The dirty hands and feet left a clue and almost dragged me into the water! And that kid from the bookstore, why is he so nosy!
"Niuxun,"
Liu Bing's voice broke the dead silence, "Today, these two people, together with this stall of pickled food, are brought to the Zajia family for cooking. You, the food supervisor, the Zajia family will allow you to rectify it again. If you still can't understand..."
He paused and said in a calm yet serious tone, "The Za family wouldn't mind having someone else take care of it."
As if he had received an amnesty from the cow's paw print, he bowed quickly, his voice trembling with the tremor of the rest of his life, "Thank you, ancestor, for your grace! I must straighten this out! I must straighten it out!"
"Hmph."
Liu Bing stopped looking at him and ordered the people around him, "Take everyone who should be brought with you, and don't leave anything behind. If anyone dares to do anything on the road, watch your skin carefully!"
"Yes!" All the eunuchs and eunuchs agreed in unison, stepped forward to lift up Eunuch Wang and Zhou Liupei, and lifted up the herbal tea and medicinal materials with quick and silent movements.
Liu Bing turned around and left, Manager Wu quickly followed in small steps, and Li Yeqing also silently followed behind his godfather.
The group of people walked through the palace walls, the sound of footsteps was barely audible, and the atmosphere was depressing.
Walking to the corner of a secluded palace garden, Liu Bing stopped and said to Mr. Wu, "Let your people take the things to the inner palace to wait."
"Yes." Manager Wu quickly motioned to the other eunuchs to go ahead.
After the others left, only Liu Bing, Manager Wu and Li Yeqing were left at the scene.
Liu Bing's eyes really fell on Li Yeqing for the first time. He looked up and down, and suddenly spoke, his voice still gentle, but with a hint of inquiry, "Boy, you are very skilled. It would be a pity to stay in the library. There is a shortage of smart people in the East Factory. There are not so many twists and turns in the palace. Do you want to go?"
Li Yeqing was shocked in his heart, but did not dare to show it on his face. He bowed his head respectfully, "Back to my ancestors, I am grateful to you for your respect. It's just... there are still some trivial matters in the library that Her Royal Highness Princess Lian has given me that have not been completed. I need to report back to Your Highness before I can leave."
When Liu Bing heard this, the usual "kind" smile on his face became more real, and he actually said with a bit of ridicule, "Oh, I forgot about your relationship. That's all, if that girl knows that the Zajia has pried her off, she will have to come and pull out these precious beards of the Zajia! It's not easy for people like us to save a few beards, so the Zajia must keep them."
His tone was slightly slower, with a hint of imperceptible approval, "However, you are a good boy. You know how to repay kindness and stay calm in times of crisis. Xiao Wu, you are a godson, and you have done well."
Manager Wu next to him didn't dare to straighten up his waist until now. He let out a long sigh of relief and said with an apologetic smile, "My ancestors are so ridiculous. It's all thanks to you that the child is lucky not to embarrass you."
"Fu?"
